$comment: sf-admin-activity, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): what runs in the background of an admin, at the end of the crumbs row and in the phone top line. Owner decision C421 (with C332, C339, C342); study ui-control control/research/2026-11-22-admin-shell-study, sample prototypes/admin-shell-study/shell.mjs setupActivity. The runs are the host's: the setting runs, or activity.load when the host's port offers activity.

runs.x-markup: the attribute takes the same list as JSON; the property wins
runs.summary: The host's runs, set anew on every change: each {id, label, state (running|failed|done|cancelled), value, total, unit, text, href, object, cancelable, retryable}. A run that leaves running, first appears already done or failed, or is dropped while running, ended: the element tells it once. The first list it is given tells nothing.

history-href.summary: The address of the activity history: «Все действия» at the list's foot, and where a failure's notification leads when the run has no href.

size.summary: The trigger's rung: 1/2 in the crumbs row, 1 in the phone top line beside the bell.

placement.summary: Where the list opens from the trigger.

notify.summary: A run's end says itself: SF.notify success (gone by itself) or error (stays until closed, C339) and a notification in the admin's list (C332). Off, only the event finished.

open.summary: The list opened (vocabulary open): the failures in it count as seen and the mark goes.

retry.summary: «Повторить» on a failed run; over a port the element asks activity.retry {id} and reads again.

cancel.summary: «Отменить» on a running run; over a port the element asks activity.cancel {id} and reads again.

finished.summary: A run ended (state done or failed), once for the page. Cancelled, the element says nothing of it (no toast, no notification).

refresh.summary: Reads the runs again (activity.load) when the port offers activity.

show.summary: Opens the list; refused when there is nothing to show.

side-effects: SF.notify when a run ends (setting notify)
sf-admin-notifications add when a run fails (setting notify)

relations.name: cl-badge
$comment: «Идёт N», «Не удалось N» and the failure mark are sf-badge.

relations.name: cl-popover
$comment: The list opens in sf-popover from the trigger.

relations.name: cl-progress-run
$comment: A run is sf-progress-run in the notice look; drawn only when the list opens.

skeleton.$comment: No late data, no skeleton: the runs are the page's state when it is printed (the setting runs) or the host's answer to activity.load (port 1.2.0), and an indicator with nothing to show draws nothing (C421), so there is no box to hold before they come. Declared because the element names the navigation port, which would otherwise make its list setting late (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: The trigger is a native button with a name that says the counts in words («Действия в фоне: идёт 2, не удалось 1»); the badges are hidden from a reader. A polite status says the counts once per change, not each percent. The list is sf-popover's: Escape closes it and the focus returns to the trigger.

x-summary: The admin's background activity: «Идёт N» while something runs, a red failure mark beside it until the list was opened, «Не удалось N» in words when nothing runs, no element when nothing is to show; the list of runs in sf-popover; a run's end said by SF.notify and, for a failure, a notification.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf over Framework parts: the trigger a native quiet button with sf-badge, the list sf-popover of sf-progress-run rows in the notice look (C342).

what shows (C421): «Идёт N» while something runs; a failure meanwhile is an icon-only red mark beside it until the list was opened; when nothing runs, «Не удалось N» in words; nothing running or failed, the element draws nothing.

ends (C339, C332): done → SF.notify success, which goes by itself; failed → SF.notify error, which stays until closed, and a notification added to every sf-admin-notifications of the page. Told once per run's end for the page (two indicators, the crumbs row's and the phone top line's, share it on a global: every bundle carries its own module copy).

Retry (AS-4, sf-progress-run 1.6.0): a failed, retryable run's notice row draws «Повторить» before «Развернуть» and sends sf-progress-run-retry, which the element turns into its retry {id} and, over a port with activity, activity.retry {id}. The set's own sf-button under the row (the fallback until AS-4) is gone with the repin onto the Framework that carries AS-4.

port editions (AN-2): the indicator takes simai.admin-navigation-port 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 (x-port.supports; js/port.js). A host that declares 1.2.0 or later (major 1) and lists the capability activity is asked activity.load when the port connects and on refresh; Retry asks activity.retry {id}, Cancel activity.cancel {id}, and the runs of the answer (activity_page) are taken as they are after it, or read again when the answer carries none. A run's retryable false (1.2.0, or the setting runs) offers no Retry. A 1.1.0 host has no activity: it is asked nothing, and the setting runs is the way.

run.const: A run: id, label, state (running|failed|done|cancelled), value, total, unit, text, href, object, cancelable.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-admin-activity at the end of the crumbs row of an admin page and in the phone top line of sf-admin-shell (slot top-end), with the host's runs.
do_not: Do not run the actions in the element; the host runs them
Do not send percents as separate toasts: set runs anew and the element tells only the end
Do not draw it when nothing runs: it draws nothing by itself

accessibility.focus: The trigger in reading order; the list is sf-popover's, the focus returns to the trigger when it closes.
